no medical advice, laboratory procedure, automatic action, or feedback intake.
It opens only Check Meaning; it records no current choice and performs no deed.

# Memes, brainrot, identity, and society — bounded social lineage

- Corrections: source repository issues (source kept private)

Boundaries: the KINGDOM guest JSON is the single structured factual home.
Meme artifact, exposure, attention, sharing, belief, identity, norm,
institution, and harm stay separate. Brainrot is a polysemous folk term, not a
diagnosis or verdict on a person or generation. Biology is analogy-only; no
mechanism transfers and people are not hosts. The page opens only Check
Meaning. It changes no feed, runs no model, performs no surveillance,
persuasion, targeting, identity inference, diagnosis, scoring, or action.

The field lab uses nondimensionalized toy mathematics, makes no domain-specific
or medical inference, sends no input anywhere, and starts no next turn.
